profile.name: Ed Martinez
profile.summary: Data & Analytics executive with 15+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale data transformations, building high-performing teams, and driving strategic decisions through advanced analytics and AI/ML. Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact across financial services, healthcare, and technology sectors.

bullets.text: Led a 45-person data organization spanning analytics engineering, data science, and business intelligence across 3 business units
Drove $12M annual cost savings by architecting a unified data platform on Snowflake, consolidating 7 legacy data warehouses
Launched enterprise ML ops pipeline processing 2B+ daily events for real-time fraud detection, reducing false positive rate by 38%
Established data governance framework with 200+ data quality rules, improving data trust score from 62% to 94%
Built executive analytics dashboard suite adopted by C-suite and board, enabling data-driven quarterly strategic planning
Presented data strategy roadmap to board of directors, securing $8M multi-year investment in data infrastructure modernization
Managed a team of 28 data scientists, analysts, and engineers delivering predictive analytics for population health management
Developed patient readmission prediction model achieving 0.89 AUC, preventing an estimated 4,200 unnecessary readmissions annually saving $31M
Migrated analytics infrastructure from on-prem Hadoop to AWS (Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), reducing total cost of ownership by 40%
Designed and implemented A/B testing framework adopted across 5 product teams, increasing experiment velocity by 3x
Partnered with Chief Medical Officer to develop clinical analytics program, resulting in 15% improvement in care quality metrics
Built and led a 15-person analytics team from scratch, establishing the company's first centralized analytics function
Created customer segmentation model driving $18M incremental revenue through personalized marketing campaigns
Implemented demand forecasting system reducing inventory carrying costs by $6.5M annually using time-series models
Built self-service BI platform serving 500+ business users with automated reporting, reducing ad-hoc request volume by 65%
Promoted from Senior Data Analyst to Analytics Manager within 2 years based on delivery of high-impact client projects
Led analytics engagements for Fortune 500 clients across financial services, retail, and CPG industries
Developed churn prediction model for telecom client reducing annual churn by 12%, representing $22M in retained revenue

education.degree: MBA, Concentrations in Econometrics & Statistics and Strategic Management
BS in Computer Science, Minor in Mathematics
